While most qlippoths focus on wiping mortals from existence, gongorinans follow the divergent plan of trapping mortals in forms incapable of understanding their actions and performing any sin meriting condemnation to the [Outer Rifts](/Planes.aspx?ID=45). What may seem as a mercy to some is a matter of dire necessity to the gongorinans, who see killing sinful mortals as tantamount to helping their foes. **[Recall Knowledge - Fiend](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 30 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 28 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 25 [Gongorinan](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3155) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 281 **Perception** +20; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59) **Languages** [Chthonian](/Languages.aspx?ID=114); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) 100 feet **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +23, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +23, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +21, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +21 **Str** +6 **Dex** +6 **Con** +7 **Int** +1 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +4 **Items** _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [club](/Weapons.aspx?ID=357)_ --- **AC** 31 **Fort** +24 **Ref** +21 **Will** +20 **HP** 205 **Immunities** [controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=64), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598) **Resistances** [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) 10, physical 10 (except [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375)) --- **Speed** 40 feet, climb 40 feet, fly 40 feet; [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732) **Melee** club +24, **Damage** 2d6+9 bludgeoning plus reject tools **Melee** pincer +23 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d10+9 slashing plus 2d6 mental and [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **Melee** tentacle +23 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6+9 bludgeoning plus 2d6 mental **Melee** stinger +23 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6+9 piercing plus gongorinan venom **Occult Innate Spells** DC 30 - **3rd** [One with Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=1619) (at will) - **6th** [Cursed Metamorphosis](/Spells.aspx?ID=1479), [Petrify](/Spells.aspx?ID=1628) - **Constant (4th)** [Unfettered Movement](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732) **Disquieting Display** ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) The gongorinan opens its maw to reveal the forms hidden there, making observers question their own bodies. Creatures in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a DC 30 Will save, after which they are temporarily immune to further Disquieting Displays for 1 minute.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature is clumsy 2 and [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but for 1 minute. **Gongorinan Venom** ([Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) **Saving Throw** Fortitude DC 30; **Stage 1** [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) and cosmetic signs appear of turning into an animal, fungus, or plant (1 round); **Stage 2** stupefied 2 and [clumsy 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) (1 round); **Stage 3** stupefied 4 and clumsy 4 (1 round); **Stage 4** [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85) as changes completely overtake the body (1 round); **Stage 5** the victim permanently transforms into an animal, fungus, or plant in mind and body as a permanent curse, and the affliction ends **Painful Limbs** The gongorinan makes up to four Strikes against different targets, each using a different limb. All four Strikes count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the gongorinan has made all the attacks. **Reject Tools** ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) A creature hit by the gongorinan's club must succeed at a DC 30 Will save or [Release](/Actions.aspx?ID=2300) any manufactured items it's holding.
